value.answer: If you mean soccer, my pick is Messi: eight Ballon d'Ors, 672 goals for Barcelona and the 2022 World Cup, and most of the lists land on him. Pelé and Ronaldo are the usual alternatives. If you mean American football, it's Tom Brady with seven Super Bowl titles, though Jerry Rice is the main alternative and Brady himself says Rice is the GOAT.
